svg.title: Northern Development Initiative Trust — Northern Development logo, stacked, 2024 Annual Report
svg.desc: Native vector artwork cut from the back cover (PDF page 49) of the trust's Annual Report 2024 (PDF created 2 May 2025): the square symbol above NORTHERN DEVELOPMENT in white, as printed on the cover's navy; the symbol's gradients are the PDF's own shadings inside vector clips. Converted to SVG by Poppler's pdftocairo; only drawing outside the logo is removed. No tracing, retyping or raster. White lettering, for a dark ground.
